prompt:
Create a true-transparent RGBA JAMVERSE '96 action sprite sheet: exactly 15 complete Dorian Mycel poses in a 5-column x 3-row grid, row-major. Keep each entire person centered with visible clear space on every side; no hand, hair or shoe touches the canvas edge. Only the player, no ball/sphere, hoop, court, floor, background, shadow, effects, text, lines, logo or other person. Basketball is a separate runtime object and is not illustrated. Crisp dark outlines, classic colorful 1990s arcade pixel art.

Exact attached character identity: Dorian Mycel, compact athletic adult human, warm medium-brown skin, clean-shaven face, strong brows, short dense vivid-purple curls, purple Chicago Condas jersey and shorts with silver/lavender trim, dark knee pads, purple wristbands, purple/silver shoes. Same face, outfit and natural two arms/hands, two legs/shoes across all poses.

DUNK-TOMAHAWK: right-facing drive, leap, cock the invisible ball behind and above the crown, then forcefully hammer it downward into a tomahawk dunk; recover and land. Ball never appears, hand only mimes it. 0 approach crouch; 1 accelerates; 2 plant step; 3 launches; 4 tucks knees; 5 rises holding invisible ball near chest; 6 draws right arm behind shoulder; 7 cocks arm high behind crown; 8 peak, elbow bent and hand behind head; 9 starts hammer swing; 10 forceful downward finish; 11 follows through; 12 descends; 13 stable low landing; 14 recovery standing. Fifteen unique linked poses, varied silhouettes, consistent Dorian scale, empty transparent gutters. Keep raised poses compact so hair and hands remain well inside their cells.
ballPolicy: Dorian-specific separate basketball follows the ball-miming body motion and releases/grabs on the reviewed event frame. Never paint a ball into the poses. Track length: 15.

cleanup.method: alpha-connected component isolation and nearest-pixel reassignment

review.reviewNotes: 15 distinct complete Dorian dunk-tomahawk poses. Warm brown skin, short dense vivid-purple curls, compact adult human anatomy, strong brows and the purple/silver Chicago Condas kit remain consistent. The separate Dorian ball follows the documented dunk-tomahawk track.
